# MAK FIN PAY

> MAK FIN PAY is an India-based digital utility payment platform for agent-led bill collection, mobile/DTH recharges and credit card bill payments, with a 3-tier (Admin / Distributor / Agent) wallet and commission system.

## About

- [Home](https://makfinpay.com/): Landing page with services overview and platform information.
- [Login](https://makfinpay.com/login): Operator portal sign-in for admins, distributors and agents.

## Public Pages

Only the landing page and the login page are publicly accessible. All dashboard routes (/admin, /distributor, /agent) require authentication and are excluded from crawling.
